label: Documents
description: How invoices and credit notes are created. Titles, introduction and closing texts, the layout and the number ranges come from your Lexware settings.

fields.label: Create documents as
fields.description: A finalized document is numbered, booked and has a PDF at once. It cannot be changed or deleted afterwards, only corrected in Lexware. A draft waits in Lexware for you to review and finalize it. Start with drafts, and always use drafts with a real Lexware account in your store's test environment.

options.label: Drafts, to review and finalize in Lexware
German for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, English elsewhere

fields.label: Create credit notes for refunds
fields.description: Each refund of an order that has a Lexware invoice becomes a credit note that names the invoice.

fields.label: E-mail documents to customers
fields.description: Sends each finalized invoice and credit note to the customer, with a link to the PDF. The e-mail can be edited under Settings → Notifications. Drafts are not sent.
